rootConstruction: SHA-256 of the file list in canonical form: "<sha256>  <path>" lines, sorted by path, LF-joined, one trailing newline — reproducible with sha256sum alone. Paths under public/ are fetchable at the same path on https://terralore.co (without the public/ prefix); repo paths are verifiable in the public git history at https://github.com/Darkhouse13/terralore. How to verify: https://terralore.co/integrity
